ai.title: Fix system prompt caching for --max mode
ai.summary: Updated warmCacheForRequestRelevantFiles in backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts to use getModelForMode(costMode, 'file-requests') instead of hardcoded claudeModels.haiku. Ensures cache warming matches the active cost mode, preventing cache misses when using --max. Also tightened getRelevantFiles signature to require explicit costMode.

eli5.text: When someone asks the assistant to search for files to work on, the system now warms its cache using the same model size that the request will actually use, instead of always defaulting to the smallest (fastest, cheapest) model. This fixes the case where a request sent in the maximum-cost mode would find an empty cache and have to do the full work over again instead of reusing a pre-built answer. The fix means those cache lookups now line up with the requested cost setting, so the system can reuse its prepared responses instead of ignoring them. This is live today for any request that runs in maximum-cost mode.

ai.title: Pricing page 3-blurb card styling
ai.summary: Updated pricing page 3-blurb cards in web/src/app/pricing/page.tsx. Added dark mode support, increased padding, and added shadow hover effects. Internal styling refactor only.

eli5.text: The three feature cards on the pricing page now have more breathing room, a subtle shadow that darkens when you hover your mouse over them, and styling that adjusts automatically whether you're viewing the page in light or dark mode. The text inside the cards also switches color to stay readable in each mode. No layout or content changed, just the visual polish of those three cards.

ai.title: Tools system prompt restructure
ai.summary: Reordered and consolidated tool usage guidelines in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts`. Moved file editing restrictions to rule 6 and added note on silent command success. Updated phrasing for tool adherence.

eli5.text: The instructions telling the assistant how to run terminal commands were reorganized and cleaned up, making the rules easier to follow. You won't see any change in what the assistant does, it still follows the same rules about not editing files with terminal commands and not running long tasks like starting a server. This is purely behind-the-scenes housekeeping to keep the guidance organized, and it's already live.

ai.title: Fix --create path handling and add logs
ai.summary: The `--create` command now respects the provided path argument for project creation. `createTemplateProject` accepts a `projectDir` parameter, constructs the full `projectPath`, and creates parent directories recursively if missing. Added console logs for template downloading, git initialization, and final success status. This change affects `npm-app/src/create-template-project.ts` and `npm-app/src/index.ts`.

eli5.text: When you run the project creation command, it now correctly places your new project in the specific folder you asked for instead of always using the current spot. Before, if you told it to create a project in a particular directory path, it would ignore that instruction and use the wrong location. The program also now shows you status messages as it works, so you can see it downloading templates, setting up version control, and confirming when everything finished successfully.
